sayLines.text: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Leo speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Zoe.
📓 Codex: Thornfield split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 1 petition at Haven's fire.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Leo speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🧳 A traveler says Thornfield burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
In The Red Table, mothers tell the story of the night you stood between. The children ask for it by name.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Zoe of The Red Table with 4 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Zoe of The Red Table raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Zoe of The Red Table didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 999 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."
📓 Codex: National beat staged: lead (4 villages).

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🍲 The shared granary opens: 5,000 kcal for every fire of the realm, no strings. Emberhold, Stonebridge, Thornfield count it — and remember who fed them first. (Trust +10 with each.)
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh. OH. Do you feel that? That's the whole PLANET leaning in. ...There's a table, little fires. A big one. Far away. And it is LOOKING at you. Give it a season worth judging."
Józef, at the fire, not quite believing it: "Speakers rode in, ate our grain, and called us a realm. A REALM. I keep saying it to hear how it sounds."
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. Not yet. The table is being set for those whose deeds are done, and yours are not done. The ledger still wants: the food-thesis deeds. The climb is not over.

◈ SYSTEM: "32. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
🧳 Word from The Red Table: Hana is dead, and Rosa and June both claim the fire. The Red Table is choosing — or fighting.
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,189 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Nevermore is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

🔥 Tetsuya takes up a brand and Xavier follows — they meet it at the edge of the light with noise and fire. Nevermore was never brave. It melts back into the dark. (The watch drove off the feast's scavenger. The devotion stays armed; the feast's fire still burns in you.)
◈ The realm came apart — no polity answers to Haven now, and Haven is a free fire again. National and global no longer describe this village. The climb starts over.
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 1,110 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
🥣 Tomás of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Tomás waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
🖱️ The Algorithm trailers its next move at Yasmin — the predictable get countered.
🖱️ The Algorithm trailers its next move at Katarina — the predictable get countered.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Algorithm: Lose on purpose — tank the prediction. It is about the NEXT action, not your history — the predictable get countered. Lose on purpose: stand there and take the soft prediction for two rounds and its model goes mushy. (The most engaging thing is an upset; be the upset.) (Katarina lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
